title: Upravljanje tajnama: HashiCorp Vault
summary: Vault u pipelineu: KV v2, HCL politike, AppRole i JWT auth za GitLab id_tokens, dinamičke tajne sa lease-om i dostava tajni aplikaciji preko Vault Agenta ili External Secrets Operatora.
summary_en: Vault in the pipeline: KV v2, HCL policies, AppRole and JWT auth for GitLab id_tokens, dynamic secrets with leases, and delivering secrets to the application via Vault Agent or the External Secrets Operator.
